quests.instruction: Touch the body part that has your eyes, nose, and mouth on it. It is also the one you wash every morning to feel fresh, but it is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Hint: You wash it every morning with water.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: No two faces are exactly alike, except sometimes identical twins.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we brush every morning to make it neat. It is NOT your ears!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You comb or brush this part every day!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Hair helps protect your scalp from the sun.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to jump high like a bunny. It is NOT your toenails!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you use them to walk!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your legs contain the longest and strongest bones in your body.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that turns pink when you feel shy or cold. It is also the one you puff up big when you blow out candles, but it is NOT your soles!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Hint: They turn rosy pink when you feel shy.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Cheek muscles are used heavily when you smile or blow up a balloon.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where your arms connect to your body. It is also the one you lift up high when you play airplane, but it is NOT your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found where your arms begin.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your shoulders have the widest range of motion of any joint.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to pick up a small button. It is also the one that wiggles when you play the piano, but it is NOT your thumbs!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Think about this: You use these to point and count.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? you have unique fingerprints that no one else in the world has.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the very back of your foot, below your ankle. It is also the one you click together in a fun, silly dance, but it is NOT your shins!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: They are the round back part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: The heel is connected to the calf muscle by the Achilles tendon.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right in the middle of your arm. It is also the one you bend to lean on the table while you eat your dinner, but it is NOT your fingers!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Hint: They are between your shoulder and your wrist.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: Elbows allow you to bring food up to your mouth.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that stretches out wide when you fly like an airplane. It is also the one you use to carry your favorite teddy bear, but it is NOT your wrists!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Think about this: Your hands are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your arms help you swing, hug, and reach for things high up.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you hear someone call your name. It is also the one that never stops working, even while you are asleep, but it is NOT your armpits!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Think about this: Cover these and sounds become quiet.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your ears never stop hearing, even when you are fast asleep.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you press together gently to blow a kiss. It is also the one that curves up into a big happy smile, but it is NOT your eyes!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Hint: You press these together to blow a kiss.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Lips help you form different sounds when you are speaking.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps hold your shoulder steady and in place. It is NOT your belly button!
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is just below your neck!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: It sits right underneath the skin at the base of your neck.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to lick a melting ice cream cone. It is also the one that moves around your mouth to help you speak clearly, but it is NOT your forehead!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Think about this: It lives inside your mouth and moves when you talk.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that a doctor studies to make sure all your bones are healthy. It is NOT your bones!
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the name for ALL your bones together!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: Bones in your skeleton are constantly growing and repairing.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that acts as bendy spots, helping your whole body move smoothly. It is NOT your collarbone!
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They let parts of your body bend!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: A special fluid lubricates joints so they move smoothly.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you rub together to warm up on a cold day. It is also the one we open flat to catch raindrops falling from the sky, but it is NOT your thumbs!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: They are the flat, inside part of your hands!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Palms have a thick layer of skin to protect them from friction.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that feels if something is soft, rough, hot, or cold. It is also the one that wraps around your entire body, like a big, snug coat, but it is NOT your ribs!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: It covers every single part of your body!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Skin helps regulate your body temperature by sweating.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that you keep healthy by brushing gently every day. It is NOT your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They hold your teeth in place!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: Gums hold your teeth firmly in place in your jawbone.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that moves up and down when you bend your leg. It is NOT your shins!
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is a small, round bone on your knee!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: Its medical name is the patella.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you think, learn, and remember your favorite song. It is also the one found safely inside your head, protected by your skull, but it is NOT your backbone!
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: Think about this: It is safe inside your head.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: It uses about 20% of all the oxygen you breathe.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we clap together to cheer for our friends. It is also the one we wash with soap and water before we eat, but it is NOT your arms!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your arms.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? more than a quarter of the motor cortex in your brain is devoted to your hands.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps your arm swing and lift with ease. It is NOT your collarbone!
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is flat and shaped like a triangle!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: Its medical name is the scapula.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that beats inside your chest and pushes blood all around your body. It is also the one you can feel go thump, thump, thump if you rest your hand on your chest, but it is NOT your muscles!
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think about this: It is about the size of your fist.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: Your heart is roughly the size of your clenched fist.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a long row of small bones down the middle of your back. It is also the one that lets you bend forward, backward, and side to side, but it is NOT your lungs!
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: Think about this: It helps you bend and stand up tall.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: It allows you to bend, twist, and stand up straight.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that lets your fingers bend and curl, not your arms!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are on the back of your hand, where your fingers bend.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: The skin over your knuckles is extra loose to allow bending.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found right below your chest. It is also the one that fills up when you eat a tasty snack, but it is NOT your shoulders!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: It rumbles when you are hungry!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: When your tummy rumbles, it usually means it's empty.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found inside your neck, where your voice comes from, not your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Food travels through here on its way to your tummy.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: The throat is lined with mucous to keep it moist.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that you cannot see without a mirror. It is also the one we rest against a chair when we sit down, but it is NOT your limbs!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Hint: You lie on this to look up at the sky.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back muscles allow you to pull heavy objects.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is hard and strong, and holds your whole body up. It is also the one that a doctor can see clearly using a special X-ray picture, but it is NOT your heart!
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: Think about this: A doctor can see these with an X-ray.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: Inside your bones is marrow, which makes red blood cells.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that gets gently squeezed when you hug someone tight, not your elbows!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Your arms rest against these when they hang down.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Armpits are usually one of the warmest parts of your skin.
